QuestInfo.0: You've overcame peril by working with Neinheart on the Lumiere.

0.0: #b#h0##k,\r\nThank you for your hard work aboard the Lumiere, #h0#. You saved us quite a bit of trouble.
0.1: Of course, the whole idea of breaking the containers to escape came from me, so...
0.2: We both did well, but I believe I owe you my thanks, #h0#.
0.3: We came together in a moment of peril, so I would like to show you a little gratitude, #h0#. Will you accept it?

no.0: If you don't want it, I certainly won't force it on you.

yes.0: I hope you will be able to support the Empress and the Alliance again in the future.
